1b1(mdo sde): @##//rgya gar skad du/Ar+ya b+ha dra ka lI ka nA ma ma hA rA na sU tra/bod skad du/'phags pa bskal pa bzang po bzhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/bam po dang po/sangs rgyas 
1b2(mdo sde): dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs te/dbyar gnas par bzhugs 
1b3(mdo sde): pa zhugs nas/dbyar zla gsum 'das pa dang /chos gos mdzad do//chos gos mdzad nas/chos gos mnabs te/lhung bzed thogs nas/yangs pa can gyi grong khyer ga la 
1b4(mdo sde): ba der/dge slong 'bum dang yang thabs cig/byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad cu snyed dang yang thabs cig tu gshegs te/byon nas tshal chen por gshegs pa dang /nang du yang 
1b5(mdo sde): dag 'jog las bzhengs so//byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po de yang nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs pa las/nang du yang dag 'jog pas langs te/dge slong 
2a1(mdo sde): @#//gi 'khor dang /dge slong ma'i 'khor dang /dge bsnyen gyi 'khor dang /dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor dang /lha dang /klu dang /gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang /lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen 
2a2(mdo sde): po'i 'khor dag dang lhan cig tu stan pa ting ba la 'dug go/byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang snang ba thob pa/gzungs thob pa/ting nge 'dzin thob pa/mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/tshig gzung bar 'os pa/tshul 'chos pa med pa/shes 
2a3(mdo sde): kyi khe dang /chags sems dang bral ba/zang zing med par chos ston pa/chos zab mo la bzod pa'i pha rol tu son pa/mi 'jigs pa thob pa/bdud kyi las las yang dag par 'das pa/las kyi sgrib pa spangs pa/chos kyi rang bzhin 
2a4(mdo sde): la the tshom med pa thob pa/bskal pa grangs med par smon lam shin tu bsags pa/bzhin 'dzum pa/gsod por smra ba/khro gnyer med pa/tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smra ba/sems zil gyis mi non pa/spobs pa rgyun mi 
2a5(mdo sde): 'chad pa/mnyam pa nyid la bzod pa thob pa/'khor mtha' yas pa zil gyis gnon cing ma 'jigs pa thob pa/tshig gcig gis bskal pa bye ba tshar phyin bston pa la mkhas pa/chos thams cad la sgyu ma dang /smig rgyu dang /chu zla dang /rmi lam 
2a6(mdo sde): dang /brag ca dang mtshungs par mos pa/shes pa mi 'jigs pa tshad med pa/sems can gyi sems kyi rgyu ba phra mo'i tshul dang /spyod pa sna tshogs shes pa la mos pa/dge ba rgya che ba sems thogs pa med pa/lhag pa'i nga rgyal med cing 
2b1(mdo sde): bzod pa dang ldan pa/dge ba ji lta ba bzhin du rlabs che ba/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas par smon lam rab tu bzung ba/'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag par rgyun du mngon du gyur pa/sangs rgyas 
2b2(mdo sde): dpag tu med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa la mkhas pa/lta ba tha dad pa dang /bag la nyal dang /kun nas dkris pa'i nyon mongs pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa la mkhas pa/ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rol pa brgya stong bsgrub pa la mkhas pa sha stag la 'di lta 
2b3(mdo sde): ste/byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa dang /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /'brug sgra dang /dge ba brgya stong gi me tog kun tu rgyas pa'i blo dang /bsgrub pa mtha' yas pa'i blo can 
2b4(mdo sde): glog gis rab tu brgyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang /chags pa med pa'i mtha' dang ldan pa'i blo can dang /rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po dang /'thun pa dang mi 'thun pa mthong bar gyur pa dang /gser stug po bsags pa'i 'od gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dang /
2b5(mdo sde): dpag tshad brgyar rnam par lta zhing 'gro ba dang /spobs pa brtsegs pa dang /ye shes phung po dang /mthong ba don yod dang /bzang skyong la sogs pa dang /skyes bu dam pa brgyad po gang spos kyi glang po dang /rin chen mtha' yas mdzod dang /shes 
2b6(mdo sde): rab brtsegs pa dang /mchod pa bkod pa dang /seng ge rnam par sgrogs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang /blo'i bkod pas legs par brgyan pa la gnas pa dang /seng ge'i stabs kyis 'gro ba dang /spobs par mtha' yas par bsgrub pa la 'jigs 
2b7(mdo sde): pa med pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa dang /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gang dag rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams dang /brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang /dbang sgyur dang /tshangs pa chen 
3a1(mdo sde): @#//po dang /klu'i bdag po dang /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po dang /lha ma yin gyi bdag po dang /nam mkha' lding gi bdag po dang /mi'am ci'i bdag po dang /lto 'phye chen po'i bdag po dang /dri za'i bdag po dang /de dag thams cad bcom 
3a2(mdo sde): ldan 'das ga la ba der dngo ste/bcom ldan 'das la me tog sil mas gtor nas 'khod par gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos nyin zhag bdun zas bcad de 'chag cing 'greng la 'dug bzhin du glos ma phab par rmugs pa 
3a3(mdo sde): dang /gnyid med par mngon par brtson par gyur to//de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mcho ga tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to//byang chub sems dpa' chos gang rdzogs par bgyis na sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang 
3a4(mdo sde): spyod pa 'tshal bar 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bka' la 'jug par 'gyur ba dang /phyin ci log tu ston pa las mi ston par 'gyur ba dang /sgra ji lta ba bzhin du bden pa shes pa la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas thams 
3a5(mdo sde): cad la sgrib pa med par 'gyur ba dang /'di lta ste sangs rgyas dang 'grogs pa 'thob cing mthong ba dang /chos kyis nges pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dang /'jig rten gyi chos la yang spyod la 'jig rten pas kyang mi gos par 'gyur ba dang /snyoms par 'jug pa la/
3a6(mdo sde): gnas kyang de der skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang /mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la spyod kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgya kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma bgyis par nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos la spyod kyang theg pa de dag gis 
3a7(mdo sde): nges par mi 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la sems nag nog ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang /khams sna tshogs la yang 'jug la thams cad kyi rjes su yang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang /zhu ba dang /spobs pa'i bsam pa la zil gyis 
3b1(mdo sde): non par mi 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa rab tu 'dzin cing shes rab ma lus par 'thob par 'gyur ba dang /sems can rnams yongs su smin pa rab gyi da la sems can gyi 'du shes la yang mi gnas par 'gyur ba dang /chos kyang ston la 
3b2(mdo sde): dmigs pa la yang mi gnas pa dang /mya ngan las 'das pa yang smra la/nye bar zhi ba gang yang mi dmigs par 'gyur ba dang /byang chub kyi phyir yang spyod la mi gnas par yang 'gyur ba dang /mchis pa dang /ma mchis pa yongs su spangs kyang rgya chen po la mos 
3b3(mdo sde): par 'gyur bar bgyid pa dag/bcom ldan 'das bdag ma 'tshal bzhin du ni mi zhu na/'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to//lha mi gnod 
3b4(mdo sde): sbyin dri za 'khor mang po//mtha' yas ji ltar mos bzhin tshogs lags pas//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang //'jig rten dag gi mgon po 'od mdzad pa//smra ba'i zla ba la ni zhu lags na//go rims bzhin du bdag la lung bstan gsol//
3b5(mdo sde): byang chub spyod mchog yon tan thos nas ni//skye bo phal chen 'dun gyur byang chub brtson//byang chub yon tan mchog la dad bskyed nas//yon tan kun mthar phyin la zhu lags na//grags pa mtha' yas bdag gi sems mkhyen tam//rgyal ba ma gtogs 
3b6(mdo sde): dbang gzhan bdag la med//rgyal ba'i yon tan lha mi shin tu skom//stobs bcu'i spyod pa rnam par phye ste gsungs//yon tan mchog spyod byang chub yon tan byung //sngags mdzes tshul chen khyod kyi mkhyen spyod gsungs//ji nas ye shes 'od zer 'phro bgyid cing //
3b7(mdo sde): nag po'i rtsa lag dpung bcas 'joms bgyid la//ji nas stong gsum myur du g.yo bgyid pa//de 'dra'i byang chub spyod pa bde gshegs gsungs//ji nas mtshan gyi me tog rgyas 'gyur zhing //ji nas mtha' yas dbyangs ldan 'gyur ba dang //ji nas ri rab 'dra 
4a1(mdo sde): @#//ba'i ting 'dzin 'gyur//de 'dra'i byang chub sems spyod bshad du gsol//mnyam med mtshungs med g.yo med tshul 'chos med//dbral dgra bcom dri gsum dri bral ba//dge spyod mchog ste mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bstod//khyod la mi 
4a2(mdo sde): mchog dag gi spyod pa zhu//rtogs blo brtan po dran ldan me tog gsung //'khrul med legs spyad spyod mnga' smra ba'i mchog/dri bsal skyes bzang khyu mchog phan mdzad pa//ci nas rgyal 'gyur de ltar bdag la gsungs//khyod las nyin mtshan dag tu 'di 
4a3(mdo sde): dag gis//mnyan nas byang chub spyod pa yang dag la//yid la byed pa gzhan med bde ba yis//spyod pa 'di la mchog tu spyod par 'gyur//ji nas ting 'dzin ldan zhing gzungs ldan dang //ji nas blo dang shes rab spobs ldan dang //phyogs mtha' 
4a4(mdo sde): yas par sangs rgyas mthong ba dang //tshul dang tshul min dri ba 'dri ba dang //ji ltar ye shes mtshungs med 'gyur ba dang //dge ba sgo brgya dag ni bsgrub pa dang //'chad pa la ni 'khrul pa med 'gyur ba//stobs bcu'i spyod pa khyod la zhu lags so//srid pa'i 
4a5(mdo sde): bde la chags te'ang mi zhu'o//yul gyis bsgyur slad du yang mi zhu'o//rgyal ba'i bdud rtsi la ni bdag legs 'dun//stobs bcu'i spyod pa bdag la myur du gsungs//de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' mchog 
4a6(mdo sde): tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po legs so legs so//chos thams cad kyi tshul la nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin de dang ldan na yon tan de dag 'thob par 'gyur 
4a7(mdo sde): ro//gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su rdzogs par byed do//ting nge 'dzin stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'thob par 'gyur ro//gzungs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi' thob par 'gyur ro//sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la 'jug 
4b1(mdo sde): pa mkhas pa yang rtogs par 'gyur ro//myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang 'gyur ro//mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po chos thams cad kyi tshul la nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin reg bzhin 
4b2(mdo sde): 'di lta ste ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa nyid do//ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du smra ba nyid do//lus dag par byed do//ngag dag par byed do//sems dag par byed do//phan par 'dod pa nyid do//byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa nyid do//snying rje nyid mi spong ba'o//
4b3(mdo sde): 'dod pa dag la don du mi gnyer ba nyid do//chos don du gnyer ba nyid do//dad pa chung za bar mi byed pa'o//rang gis dam bcas pa kun tu spyod pa nyid do//nges pa'i tshig la mkhas pa'o//sems can sgrol ba'o//cang shes kyi las can no//lus la mi brkam 
4b4(mdo sde): pa nyid do//sems rgyu ba med pa nyid do//sdug bsngal dang ldan pa rnams la tshim par byed pa nyid do//bde ba dang ldan pa rnams la gzengs stod pa'o//bag med pa rnams la 'doms pa'o//brtson pa rnams la 'chos pa'o//chos la 'gyod pa dag sel ba nyid do//sems 
4b5(mdo sde): can gyi 'du shes la mi gnas pa'o//dngos po'i 'du shes kyis rtog pa med pa'o//'dzin pa yongs su gcod pa'o//mtshan ma rnam par 'jig pa nyid do//mnyam par gzhag pa la g.yo ba med pa'o//rtag tu ye shes 'tshol ba'o//'jig rten pa'i gtam 
4b6(mdo sde): rnam par spong ba nyid do//'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtam 'tshol ba nyid do//dran pa nyams pa med pa nyid do//chos rnams la brjod pa med pa nyid do//ji ltar bya ba bzhin du 'jug pa'o//spyod pa sgrub pa'o//'jig rten shes pa nyid do//las la mngon par yid 
4b7(mdo sde): ches pa nyid do//ma dad pa yongs su spong ba nyid do//mos pa mang ba nyid do//sangs rgyas yid la byed pa'o//'phel ba ston pa'o//bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba nyid do//sangs rgyasal gsol ba 'debs pa nyid do//sbyin gnas la phyag 'tshal ba nyid

5b1(mdo sde): mi dmigs pa nyid do//yul la mi ston pa'o//phyin ci log spong ba'o//sems brtan por bsgrub pa'o//'phags pa'i gnas pa'o//sems la brkam chags med pa nyid do//sbyin gnas kyis thob pa nyid do//mngon par 'du byed pa shin tu sbyangs pa'o//sbyin pas rnam

5b3(mdo sde): rang gi yon tan gyis snyems pa med pa nyid do//gzhan gyi yon tan la sun mi ma byin pa'o//'khor ba la mi gnas pa'o//mya ngan las 'das pa la mi dmigs pa nyid do//dpyad pa la dbang du gyur pa'o//mya ngan las 'dasapa la ma chags pa'o//nges pa la gnas

5b5(mdo sde): la bsngags pa brjod pa'o//tshogs pa la mngon par brtson pa'o//mdza' ba dang mi 'dza' ba la sems mnyam pa nyid do//gzungs 'tshol ba'o//sems can rnams la ni ma la sri zhu che ba lta bu'o//mdzangs pa la ni pha la sri zhu che ba lta bu'o/bla ma rnams

6a1(mdo sde): @#//gnas yongs su spong ba'o//khyim pa rnams la mi bstod pa'o//rab tu byung ba rnams kyi nang na 'du 'dzi la mi gnas pa'o//tshul 'chos pa med pa nyid do//kha gsag med pa nyid do//snyan par smra ba nyid do//byang chub yang dag bar len du 'jug pa nyid do//
6a2(mdo sde): rang bzhin gyis zhum pa med pa nyid do//tshul bzhin la 'jug pa'o//phyir zhing sangs rgyas la bstod pa nyid do//chos la rtag tu sems pa nyid do//dge 'dun la rtag tu rjes byed pa'o//shes pa dang ldan pa rnams la rtag tu mchod pa byed pa'o//mdzangs 
6a3(mdo sde): pa rnams la rtag tu bsten pa'o//bsam gtan pa rnams la rtag tu bsrung ba'o//rigs pa dang ldan pa rnams las rtag tu skul ma 'debs pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rtag tu ston pa'o//chos rnams la rtag tu bsgom pa'o//bsod nams la rtag tu yid 
6a4(mdo sde): ches pa nyid do//sems can rnams la rtag tu yangs pa'o//dad pa dang ldan pa rnams la rab tu byams pa'o//sdug bsngal dang ldan pa rnams sel ba'o//spyod lam dag par byed pa'o//mi tshe shes pa dang khrel yod pa'o//ngo tsha ba dang 'jigs pa ston pa'i tshul 
6a5(mdo sde): can no//spyod pa ngan pa spong ba nyid do//cho ga la bsten pa'o//spong ba la mngon du phyogs pa'o//'phags pa'i gnas pa tshol ba'o//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bsgom pa'o//yang dag par spong ba bsten pa'o//dbang po rnams 'dzin pa'o//stobs rnams zil gyis 
6a6(mdo sde): mi non pa'o//byang chub kyi yan lag rnams lhag par mthong ba'o//lam la phyin ci ma log pa nyid do//zhi gnas rgya che ba'o//lhag mthong la skul ma 'debs pa'o//sems brjed ngas pa med pa nyid do//chos la mngon par dga' ba'o//dmigs pa las yang dag par 
6a7(mdo sde): 'das pa'o//mi gnas pa la mi skrag pa'o//dmigs pa med pa la bag med pa'i 'du shes dang bral ba'o//byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa kun tu bsrung ba nyid do//sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa tshad med par byed pa'o//mi 'thun pa'i spyod pa la smod pa nyid do//sngon 
6b1(mdo sde): kyi mngon par 'du byed pa la yid byung ba'o//rang gi las yongs su sbyong zhing 'dul ba ma yin pa sbed pa'o//bstan pa sun mi 'byin pa'o//the tsom mi 'dzin pa'o//dus su spyod pa nyid do//dus ma yin pa rnam par spong ba nyid do//'gro ba dang ldog pa la mkhas pa'o//
6b2(mdo sde): tshod shes pa nyid do//yo byad kyis chog shes pa'o//mngon par shes pa rgya che ba'o//ting nge 'dzin khong du chud pa'o//spyod pa'i bye brag can no//snying stobs rgya che ba'o//de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bstan pa'o//mi dmigs pas yongs su bzung ba'o//
6b3(mdo sde): brtson pa dang ldan pa rnams tshim par byed pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi sras rnams kyis bsgom pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nor yin no//sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas pa'o//mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod pa'o//cang shes kyi 'gros kyi spyod yul ba'o//chos smra 
6b4(mdo sde): ba rnams kyi spyod yul lo//mos pa mang ba rnams la spel ma 'debs pa'o//'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mthong ba'i tshul can no//nor don du gnyer ba rnams kyi mdzod do//rnam par smin pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhing ngo //gdungs pa rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba'o//
6b5(mdo sde): gzungs thob pa rnams kyi skyed mos tshal lo//ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams kyi rdzing ngo //chos dkar po dang ldan pa rnams kyi ma'o//gtam la mos pa rnams kyi gnas so//mtshan rnams kyi rgyu'o//dpe byad rnams rnam par 'byed pa'o//sangs rgyas kyi zhing 
6b6(mdo sde): yang dag pa'i gnas so//gzungs rab tu thob pa'o//bsgrub pa khong du chud pa'o//shin tu rigs par smra ba nyid do//bdud kyi yul las 'das pa'o//dpa' bo rnams kyi yul lo//nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'o//mi dge ba 'jil ba'o//smon lam dang ldan pa rnams kyi rgyan 
6b7(mdo sde): no//bdud kyis mi phyed pa'o//bstan pa zad mi shes pa'o//mu stegs can rnams kyis shes par dka' ba'o//'jig rten dang mi mtshungs pa'o//nyan thos kyi chos las 'das pa'o//rang byang chub kyis nges par ma byung ba'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang dag par zhugs 
7a1(mdo sde): @#//pa'o//sems can gyi 'gro ba la 'jug pa'o//yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du skul ma 'debs pa'o//bza' ba 'dod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'o//btung ba 'dod pa rnams kyi ro bro ba'o//mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba rnams kyi snying po'o//mya ngan 
7a2(mdo sde): las 'das par 'gro ba rnam kyi shing rta'o//pha rol tu 'gro ba rnams kyi gru'o//rgal 'dod pa rnams kyi gzings so//snying rje can rnams kyi mar me'o//chos ston pa rnams kyi skar mda'o//mi slu bar 'dod pa rnams kyi gnas so//sbyin par 'dod pa rnams kyi nor yin 
7a3(mdo sde): no//grol bar 'dod pa rnams kyi rig pa'o//rtsed mo don du gnyer ba rnams dang bar byed pa'o//nyan pa'i bsam pa can rnams kyi rgya mtsho'o//ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams kyi ri rab bo//mig la dga' ba rnams kyi dbang po'o//blta 'dod pa rnams kyi bkod pa'o//
7a4(mdo sde): sems dang ldan pa rnams dga' ba'o//phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi gnas so/mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob pa rnams kyi bsam pa'o//las dang po ba rnams kyi bsgom pa'o//skyes bu shes pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi rgyal mtshan no//zhi gnas la bkur sti byed pa rnams kyi

8a6(mdo sde): pa'o//ma rig pa sel ba'o//phung po rnams yongs su shes pa'o//rnam par shes pa yongs su shes pa'o//ming dang gzugs sdud pa'o//skye mched drug mthong ba'o//reg pa yongs su shes pa'o//tshor ba shes pa'o//sred pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o//nye bar 
8a7(mdo sde): len pa bor ba'o//srid pa chad pa'o//skye ba choms pa'o//rga shi las 'das pa'o//sdug bsngal shin tu sbyangs pa'o//bde ba la kun tu rangs pa'o//sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba rnam par sel ba'o//grub pa rnams gnas par sbyor ba'o//dpyod 
8b1(mdo sde): pa rnams tshim par byed pa'o//snang ba skyon med pa'o//chos kyi rjes su bsgrags pa'o//skyes bu grags pa can rnams kyi mthu rtsal lo//'byung po dri ma can rnams 'khru ba'o//'jig tshogs la lta ba rnams nges par 'joms pa'o//thos pa kun tu 'dzin pa'o//
8b2(mdo sde): chos rnams kun tu 'dzin pa'o//byang chub 'khrul pa med pa nyid do//dge ba thams cad la 'jug pa mi ldog pa'o//dge ba phal cher bsags pa'o//blo bsgrub pa'i gzhi'o//brtson pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi chos kyi tshul lo//'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'phel

8b4(mdo sde): kyi bstan bcos so//phu dud dang bcas pa rnams kyi rgyal po'o//mkhas pa rnams kyi 'dren pa'o//chos dkar po rnams kyi sa bon no//rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'i bdud rtsi'o//skye ba dran pa'i gzhi'o//skye ba rab tu thob pa'o//byis pa'i chos rnams la smod 
8b5(mdo sde): pa'o//de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi yon tan yang dag pa'o//ston pa dang 'dzin pa rnam par smin pa mtha' yas pa'o//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gnas so//ston pa na bde 'gro thob par 'gyur ba'o//yi ger 'dri ba na 'jigs pa thams cad spong ba'o//
8b6(mdo sde): rgal nas phyir ldog pa med pa'o//rtogs pa brjod pa'i gnas so//'jig rten pa thams cad kyi bstan pa mnos pa'o//'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'o//da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi gter ro//ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams

9a1(mdo sde): thabs mkhas pa rab tu thob pa'o//sa'i khams bsgom pa'o//chu'i khams la 'jug pa'o//me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa'o//rlung gi khams la gnas par byed pa'o//nam mkha'i khams rnam par thar pa bsgrub pa'o//shes pa'i khams

9a6(mdo sde): bsams pa'o//cang shes kyi ngo bo'o//zhum pa med pa'i ngo bo'o//sbyin pa dang ye shes la mos pa nyid do//'khor gyi nang du zhum pa med par 'gro ba nyid do//gzhan la mi smod pa nyid do//rang gi yon tan mi brjod pa'o//byang chub kyi phyir rtag tu gnas

9b1(mdo sde): la mkhas pa'o//rjes su dran pa bsgom pa'o//mi g.yo zhing nga rgyal med pa'o//rnam par grol ba tshol ba'o//the tsom nges par byed pa'o//tshangs pa'i gnas pa bskyed pa'o//byams pa'i sems mnyam pa nyid do//snying rjes rjes su 'dzin pa nyid do//dga'

10a3(mdo sde): pa yin//byang chub yan la phreng ba rnam thar pa//rab tu skye byed zhing gi pha mthar phyin//zla ba'i 'od byed snang byed srid gsum 'das//chos mchog 'di kun zla bas bstod pa yin//sems g.yengs tshul 'chos shes khe rnyed pa dag/spangs nas dgon par bsten par

12a1(mdo sde): @#//bka' stsal to//stobs bcu'i spyod pa tshul 'di 'dzin pa ni//ma 'khrul ma 'khrugs 'dra ba yod min la//'chi med bdud rtsi 'thob cing lha yul dang //mi yul dpal byed mtshungs med rtsom par 'gyur//stobs bcus bstod pa tshul 'di 'dzin pa
